steps.en: Mount the toolbar beside your app
steps.zh: 把工具栏挂在应用旁边

steps.en: Renders the annotation toolbar into the page's corner
steps.zh: 在页面角落渲染出批注工具栏

steps.en: Activate it and click the element that is wrong
steps.zh: 激活它，点那个渲染错了的元素

steps.en: Captures selector, box, classes, styles, component path, source file:line
steps.zh: 抓下选择器、盒子、类名、样式、组件路径与源码 file:line

steps.en: Copy the structured markdown and paste it to your agent
steps.zh: 复制结构化 markdown，贴给你的 agent

steps.en: Or syncs live to the MCP server your agent reads
steps.zh: 或经 endpoint 实时同步进 agent 读取的 MCP 服务

value.en: The agent greps a real selector and file:line instead of guessing which button you meant.
value.zh: agent 拿到的是能直接 grep 的选择器和 file:line，不用再猜你说的是哪个按钮。

sources: README.md (install, usage, endpoint, npx agentation-mcp server)
